Starting from FastGPT v4.8.16, commercial edition users can import from Yuque file libraries by configuring a Yuque token and uid. This feature is currently in beta — some interactions may still need refinement.

## 1. Get the Yuque Token and UID

Go to the Yuque homepage > click your avatar > Settings to find the relevant parameters.



Follow the images below to get the Token and User ID. Make sure to assign the appropriate permissions to the Token:

**Personal Edition**:

| Get Token                       | Add Permissions                 | Get User ID                     |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| ![1. Get the Yuque Token and UID — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-33.png.webp) | ![1. Get the Yuque Token and UID — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-34.png.webp) | ![1. Get the Yuque Token and UID — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-35.png.webp) |

**Enterprise Edition**:

| Get Token                        | Get User ID                      |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| ![1. Get the Yuque Token and UID — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-109.png.webp) | ![1. Get the Yuque Token and UID — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-108.png.webp) |

## 2. Create the Dataset

Using the token and uid from the previous step, create a Dataset. Select the Yuque file library type, fill in the parameters, and click Create.

![2. Create the Dataset — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-37.png.webp)

![2. Create the Dataset — interface example](/imgs/optimized/current/yuque-dataset-create.png.webp)

## 3. Import Documents

After creating the Dataset, click `Add File` to import from your Yuque document library and follow the on-screen guidance.

The Yuque Dataset supports scheduled sync — it scans once daily at varying times. If documents have been updated, they will be synced automatically. You can also trigger a manual sync.

![3. Import Documents — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-38.png.webp)
